links.comparator_used: Fully manual clinical coding by human coders
links.outcome: Coding time, correction rate of EMR mistakes, and coder F1 score
links.effect: Coding time reduced by 40% on average; correction rates on EMR mistakes about three times better for missing codes; senior coders' F1 raised from 0.72 to more than 0.93
links.quote: In human evaluations, compared to manual coding, CliniCoCo reduces coding time by 40% on average and significantly improves the correction rates on EMR mistakes (e.g., three times better on missing codes).

design_hint: human-in-the-loop coder review of AI-suggested codes
